report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Muriel Wright Residential Center (June 9, 2026)

sources_described: The water system receives its water from Great Oaks Water Company; all of Muriel Wright Residential Center's water is pumped from Great Oaks Water Company's 20 groundwater wells. The information in the report was taken from the Great Oaks Water Company Consumer Confidence Report. Managed by MCSI Water Systems Management.

extraction_notes: Text-layer PDF read with pdftotext -layout; page numbers are PDF pages (report pages are numbered 'Page 2'..'Page 5' in the header and match). The system is a consecutive system: every table value is stated to come from the Great Oaks Water Company CCR (20 groundwater wells), except the lead/copper tap samples (6/2023). Values in parentheses are averages per the column header '(Average)'; PFOS is the one row printed without parentheses. Chlorine residual is printed in 'ppb' against an MRDL of 4 (as Cl2), almost certainly a mg/L typo; kept as printed. PFAS results are printed in ppb (multiply by 1000 for ppt); the PFOS result 0.0046 ppb (4.6 ppt) is above the 0.0040 ppb notification-level figure printed beside it, but the report discloses no violation. No violations table is included and no violation, variance or exemption is mentioned.
